# Agent Tools

> Open-source tools for AI agents from fluyeporlaweb: MCP servers, agent skills and scripts for Claude, Cursor, Windsurf and any MCP-compatible agent.

Maintainer: Pablo, fluyeporlaweb (https://x.com/fluyeporlaweb).
License: MIT (https://github.com/fluyeporlaweb/agent-tools/blob/main/LICENSE).
Repository: https://github.com/fluyeporlaweb/agent-tools

## Tools

- mcp-x-intelligence: MCP server for X/Twitter research. Status: coming soon. Standalone repo: https://github.com/fluyeporlaweb/mcp-x-intelligence
